title: Inquest follows police shooting at trailer park
article: A coroner's inquest has been called into the death of a man who was shot by police in a Duncan trailer park in March 2009.
Derek Welton, 39, apparently called 911, but police officers said he lunged at them with a knife. A Taser failed to subdue him and an officer shot him.
The inquest is scheduled for Jan. 31 to Feb. 4 at the provincial courthouse in Duncan.
Coroner's inquests are mandatory when people are killed by police. Coroner Rod MacKenzie and a jury will hear evidence from witnesses to determine the facts surrounding Welton's death.
The jury can make recommendations aimed at preventing deaths in similar circumstances.
